Asset Lab

Every object, material and sprite a game can use without drawing code: the engine's core library and the asset store's sets, converted from CC0 libraries (Kenney, KayKit, ambientCG) with where each came from and how close it fits. A shape is a few lines of named parts; r.shape('kenney-furniture:bed-single', x, y, 0, { facing }) draws it after E.addAssets(window.ASSETS['kenney-furniture']). Pick one to see it drawn by the engine beside the hero, turn it, edit its text and Apply, or Copy it. docs/ASSETS.md is the card; node tools/asset-find.mjs "tavern table" searches the same store.

Sources: . Each set records its downloads (url, date, sha256, license) and each entry its file and fit; the ledgers in src/assets/catalogs/ list every file of every source.
